target.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS time, concat('Restart: ', host) AS text, 'restart' AS tags
FROM (SELECT hostName() AS host, event_time, value,
             lagInFrame(value, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY hostName() ORDER BY event_time) AS prev
      FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.asynchronous_metric_log)
      WHERE metric = 'Uptime' AND hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter)
WHERE prev > value
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS time, concat('Lease lost: ', hostName()) AS text, 'lease' AS tags
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE ProfileEvent_CASMountLeaseLost > 0 AND hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

description: Content-addressed (CAS) storage internals for support engineers and CAS developers: garbage-collection rounds, stages and phases; the write path, ref lanes and mount leases; S3 requests by object class. Rows are collapsed; open the one the Overview pointed at.

panels.description: Finished rounds per bucket. `NotALeader` on a host is normal: only the leader runs the fold. Recurring `Error` or `Aborted` is not; `Deferred` is a cheap round that found nothing changed.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, concat(hostName(), ' ', toString(outcome)) AS series, count()
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Rounds per interval, by outcome and host

panels.description: `CASGCIsLeader_<disk>` per host. Leadership moves on restart or lease loss; two hosts at 1 at the same time is a finding (CAS-133 records the leader identity in `gc/state`).

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, concat(hostName(), ' ', replaceOne(metric, 'CASGCIsLeader_', '')) AS series, max(value)
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.asynchronous_metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND metric LIKE 'CASGCIsLeader_%' AND replaceOne(metric, 'CASGCIsLeader_', '') IN ($disk) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t, series ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: GC leader (1 = this host leads)

panels.description: `duration_ms` per finished round, all outcomes. Phase rows do not sum to it: bookkeeping between phases is untimed (CAS-134).

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, duration_ms AS "duration"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Round duration by outcome

panels.description: Finish rows, newest first, with counts and the error text. `error_code` is the structured twin of `error`.

targets.query:
SELECT event_time AS "Time", hostName() AS "Host", round AS "Round", toString(trigger) AS "Trigger", toString(outcome) AS "Outcome",
       duration_ms AS "ms", candidates_marked AS "Marked", objects_deleted AS "Deleted", entries_condemned AS "Condemned",
       entries_graduated AS "Graduated", entries_redeleted AS "Redeleted", anomalies AS "Anomalies", fence_outs AS "Fence-outs",
       error_code AS "Code", error AS "Error"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter
ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 50
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Last 50 rounds

panels.description: The three stages of the retired-cursor pipeline. Condemned this round, graduated next round, redeleted the round after; in steady state the three lines track each other with a two-round lag.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, entries_condemned AS "Condemned", entries_graduated AS "Graduated", entries_redeleted AS "Redeleted"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success'
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Stage flow per round: condemned → graduated → redeleted

panels.description: `objects_spared` (in-degree > 0 at recheck), `objects_replaced` (412-saves: a resurrection won), `objects_absent` (already gone). A steady non-zero `replaced` means writers race GC on the same content.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, objects_spared AS "Spared", objects_replaced AS "Replaced", objects_absent AS "Absent"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success'
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Retire candidates per round: spared, replaced, absent

panels.description: `manifests_deleted`: owner-removed manifest bodies deleted or found absent (a batch delete cannot tell the two apart).

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, manifests_deleted AS "Manifests"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success'
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Manifests deleted per round

panels.description: Running sums of condemned − graduated and graduated − redeleted. These are the durable backlog between stages and cannot go negative the way `CASGCPendingReclaim_*` does.

targets.query:
SELECT t, sum(cg) OVER (ORDER BY t) AS "Condemned − graduated", sum(gr) OVER (ORDER BY t) AS "Graduated − redeleted"
FROM (SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, toInt64(entries_condemned) - toInt64(entries_graduated) AS cg,
             toInt64(entries_graduated) - toInt64(entries_redeleted) AS gr
      FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
      WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success')
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Cumulative stage differences over the period

panels.description: `phase_duration_microseconds` summed per bucket and phase. On otel.demo `fold_ref_intake` and `pending_deletes` dominate; a phase that grows across rounds is the one to read in the round log.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, toString(phase) AS phase, sum(phase_duration_microseconds) / 1e6
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Phase' AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t, phase ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Phase durations per bucket, stacked

panels.description: Per phase over the selected range. S3 requests issued on GC worker pools are not attributed to their phase and LIST is missing from Phase rows entirely (CAS-135); the round-level ProfileEvents in the Finish row are complete.

targets.query:
SELECT toString(phase) AS "Phase", count() AS "Rounds",
       round(quantile(0.5)(phase_duration_microseconds) / 1e6, 2) AS "p50 s", round(quantile(0.99)(phase_duration_microseconds) / 1e6, 2) AS "p99 s",
       sum(ProfileEvents['S3ListObjects']) AS "LIST", sum(ProfileEvents['S3GetObject']) AS "GET", sum(ProfileEvents['S3HeadObject']) AS "HEAD",
       sum(ProfileEvents['S3PutObject']) AS "PUT", sum(ProfileEvents['S3DeleteObjects']) AS "DELETE"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Phase' AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY phase ORDER BY "p99 s" DESC
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Phases: duration and S3 requests per phase

panels.description: Round-level `ProfileEvents` from the Finish row. A GC round is ~55–100x the S3 cost of one insert on otel.demo, driven by GET and HEAD verification, not PUT.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, ProfileEvents['S3PutObject'] AS "PUT", ProfileEvents['S3GetObject'] AS "GET", ProfileEvents['S3HeadObject'] AS "HEAD", ProfileEvents['S3ListObjects'] AS "LIST", ProfileEvents['S3DeleteObjects'] AS "DELETE"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success'
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: S3 requests per round, by verb

panels.description: All S3 requests of a round divided by objects deleted + marked + graduated + redeleted. Six requests per garbage blob was the otel.demo figure (audit F7).

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, (ProfileEvents['S3PutObject'] + ProfileEvents['S3GetObject'] + ProfileEvents['S3HeadObject'] + ProfileEvents['S3ListObjects'] + ProfileEvents['S3DeleteObjects']) / greatest(objects_deleted + candidates_marked + entries_graduated + entries_redeleted, 1) AS "Requests per item"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter AND outcome = 'Success'
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: S3 requests per deleted object

panels.description: `CASGCEnumerationPages` (LIST pages the fold walked) and `CASBulkDeleteRequests`.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCEnumerationPages) / $interval AS "Enumeration pages", sum(ProfileEvent_CASBulkDeleteRequests) / $interval AS "Bulk delete requests"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Enumeration pages and bulk deletes per second

panels.description: `CASGCReadAhead*`: read-ahead efficiency of the fold. Wasted above miss means the prefetch window is too wide.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCReadAheadHit) / $interval AS "Hit", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCReadAheadMiss) / $interval AS "Miss", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCReadAheadWasted) / $interval AS "Wasted"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Fold read-ahead: hit, miss, wasted per second

panels.description: `CurrentMetric_MemoryTracking`. The ~1.2 GiB saw-tooth per round on otel.demo is the fold's working set (audit F19).

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, hostName() AS host, max(CurrentMetric_MemoryTracking) AS "Memory"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t, host ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Memory tracking per host

panels.description: `CASRootPut` against `CASRefCleanupObjectsDeleted`: the audit F14 balance. Written staying above cleaned means the `_log` population grows.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRootPut) / $interval AS "Written (CASRootPut)", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefCleanupObjectsDeleted) / $interval AS "Cleaned (CASRefCleanupObjectsDeleted)"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Ref-log keys written vs cleaned per second

panels.description: `CASRefSweepDeferred`, `CASRefSweepRearmed`, `CASRefStalePrecommitsReclaimed` per 5-minute bucket.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefSweepDeferred) AS "Sweep deferred", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefSweepRearmed) AS "Sweep re-armed", sum(ProfileEvent_CASRefStalePrecommitsReclaimed) AS "Stale precommits reclaimed"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Ref sweeps deferred / re-armed, stale precommits reclaimed

panels.description: `anomalies`: fold clamps surfaced and survived. Steady > 0 across rounds warrants reading the round log.

targets.query:
SELECT toUInt64(event_time) * 1000 AS t, anomalies AS "Anomalies"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_gc_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type = 'Finish' AND $timeFilter
ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: Anomalies per round

panels.description: `CASGCUnmatchedRemoveDeltas` (benign per-key no-op when occasional), `CASGCCondemnMarkerUnconfirmedCarry`, `CASGCMetaWriteAnomaly`, `CASGCHeartbeatFenceOuts`, `CASGCStuckRemovals`, `CASGCNamespaceCleanupLeaks`. All but the first must stay at zero.

targets.query:
SELECT $timeSeries, sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCUnmatchedRemoveDeltas) AS "Unmatched remove deltas", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCCondemnMarkerUnconfirmedCarry) AS "Condemn marker unconfirmed carry", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCMetaWriteAnomaly) AS "Meta write anomaly", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCHeartbeatFenceOuts) AS "Heartbeat fence-outs", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCStuckRemovals) AS "Stuck removals", sum(ProfileEvent_CASGCNamespaceCleanupLeaks) AS "Namespace cleanup leaks"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.metric_log)
WHERE hostName() IN ($host) AND $timeFilter
GROUP BY t ORDER BY t
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1

panels.title: GC anomaly counters per 5 minutes

panels.description: `gc_fold_clamp`, `gc_anomaly`, `gc_fence_out` rows with their reason and detail map.

targets.query:
SELECT event_time AS "Time", hostName() AS "Host", toString(event_type) AS "Event", namespace AS "Namespace", round AS "Round", toString(outcome) AS "Outcome", toString(reason) AS "Reason", toString(detail) AS "Detail"
FROM clusterAllReplicas('$cluster', system.cas_log)
WHERE disk_name IN ($disk) AND hostName() IN ($host) AND event_type IN ('gc_fold_clamp', 'gc_anomaly', 'gc_fence_out') AND $timeFilter
ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 200
SETTINGS skip_unavailable_shards = 1
